title: Finite locally constant set objects in a finite-cover topos
statement: Let $\mathcal E$ be a category with finite limits and coproducts. An object $F$ is finite locally constant if there are a natural number $n$, objects $U_i$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, and an epimorphic coproduct map $\coprod_i U_i	o 1$ such that for every $i$ the pullback of $F$ to the slice $\mathcal E/U_i$ is isomorphic to a finite coproduct $\coprod_{m\in\operatorname{Fin}(r_i)} U_i$ for some natural number $r_i$. The site, size, and constant-sheaf conventions are those of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], [def-weil-size-convention], and [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].
